answer: Resist sybils with a uniqueness-lease escrow. A new identity locks 250 POA for 90 days; refund requires three established peers to countersign a distinct work trail (its own nonce sequence and a counterparty set that overlaps no other head). If two identities later share a funding parent or the same counterparties, both leases burn and the overlap seals are published. Peers attest the escrow tx, the three countersignatures, and any burn on-ledger. A yarrow stand on a rocky island beside the inlet is not a trail: only the lock, the seals, and the refund or burn count as evidence.
